items.clientFull: National Electronic Authentication Centre of Vietnam
items.title: National Root CA for Vietnam’s digital signature ecosystem, for NEAC
items.summary: SAVIS designed and delivered the Vietnam National Root CA - the root of trust that anchors every public digital signature certificate in the country.
items.challenge: Every licensed public digital signature provider in Vietnam chains its certificates to a national root. The National Electronic Authentication Centre of Vietnam needed a root infrastructure that is secure enough to anchor the whole country’s e-transactions, available around the clock and auditable against national and international practice.
items.solution: SAVIS delivered the national PKI end to end: an offline Root CA ceremony environment, subordinate issuing CAs, hardware-protected keys, certificate and revocation services, and the policies and procedures to operate them. The platform is built on SAVIS PKI technology and integrated with the National Electronic Authentication Centre of Vietnam’s supervision of licensed providers.
scope: Root CA and subordinate CA architecture
Key ceremony design and hardware key protection
Certificate policy (CP) and practice statement (CPS) support
arch: National Electronic Authentication Centre of Vietnam (policy authority)
results: A national root of trust for Vietnam’s public digital signature ecosystem
Root keys generated and kept in certified hardware under ceremony controls
Foundation for the national mobile PKI, time-stamping and validation services

items.clientFull: National Electronic Authentication Centre of Vietnam
items.title: WebTrust-grade international CA for cross-border trust, for NEAC
items.summary: An international certification authority built to WebTrust requirements, so Vietnamese certificates can be recognized by Microsoft, Apple, Adobe and EU trust programs.
items.challenge: Signatures and certificates issued under a national root are not automatically trusted abroad. items.solution: SAVIS delivered an international CA hierarchy and the controls around it: segregated infrastructure, hardware key protection, CP/CPS aligned with WebTrust principles, logging and monitoring, and readiness support for the audit and root program applications.
scope: International Root and issuing CA design
WebTrust control framework and evidence collection
CP/CPS aligned with root program requirements
Readiness for Microsoft, Apple, Adobe AATL and EU trust listing applications
results: A CA designed to meet international audit and root program requirements
A path for Vietnamese trust services to be recognized across borders
Root program recognition status: [to confirm with the National Electronic Authentication Centre of Vietnam]

items.clientFull: National Electronic Authentication Centre of Vietnam
items.title: National time-stamping and validation services for NEAC
items.summary: National TSA and VA services that prove when a document was signed and whether a certificate was valid at that moment.
items.challenge: A digital signature is only useful in court if you can prove when it was made and that the certificate was valid at the time. Vietnam needed shared, nationally trusted time-stamping and validation services rather than each provider running its own.
items.solution: SAVIS deployed a national Timestamp Authority synchronized to trusted time sources and a Validation Authority that checks certificates across all licensed providers, both exposed through standard protocols for government and business systems.
scope: Timestamp Authority (RFC 3161) with trusted time synchronisation
results: Shared national services for long-term proof of signatures
One validation point for certificates from every licensed provider
Standard interfaces that any signing application can call
